neumann_bc.description: Nonzero-Neumann ghost-cell prescription for cell-centered uniform Cartesian grids (esm-spec §9.2 / §11.5). The `value` (second arg) is the outward normal derivative du/dn at the boundary. Encoding (ess-bps/ess-tox G8 matcher + ess-hjg makearray lowering, esd-6k1): ESS's `_discretize_bc!` builds the synthetic `bc` wrapper encoding kind→fn, side→dim, variable→arg, value→arg; the fn/dim sibling fields are matched by `_match_sibling_name`. One side-generic rule with `dim`=$side: the ghost reflects the LOCAL 0-based first-interior cell plus the prescribed flux, u_ghost = index($u, 0) + h·value. `$h = 1/N` is bound for the side's spatial dim by `bind_side_spacing` (`var_has_grid` first resolves the variable's grid). The makearray-region BC lowering (ess-hjg) re-indexes `index($u, 0)` into the absolute grid frame per side (min: 1+0 → u[1]; max: N-0 → u[N]), so a single 0-based rule serves both xmin and xmax. Analytic check: (u_ghost − u[boundary])/h = value = du/dn. At value=0 it reduces to the homogeneous-Neumann mirror (the `+ h·0` folds away). Mirrors ESS discretize_test.jl's reference `_neumann_rule()` and ESD's robin_bc.json sibling.
